attendees_unsupported.means: Guests were added on a calendar that sends no invitations (provider table). On an application calendar, send `notify_attendees: false` to store them without telling anybody.

conferencing_unavailable.means: `integrated` on a calendar that adds no meeting link of its own.

invalid.means: The rule does not fit the event: the start is not an occurrence of it (`…by_day`), `by_day` is wrong for the frequency, a monthly series starts on the 29th to 31st or a yearly one on 29 February (`…frequency`), `until` is before the start, a timed series has no `tzid`, or an exception’s `date` is not a date or is named twice. The description says which.
The value is not acceptable (a time, a time zone, end before start…).

invalid_callback_url.means: The callback URL is not an https URL.

invalid_callback_url_blocked.means: CalMonkey will not call that host: local, private or example addresses, or a port other than 443.

invalid_format.means: `attendees` is not an object with `invite` and / or `remove`. Also on `recurrence` that is not an object or null, and on a `by_day` entry that is not an object.

invalid_json.means: The body is not a JSON object (`base`).

invalid_type.means: Wrong type, such as a number where a string belongs.

invalid_value.means: Not one of the allowed values (e.g. `transparency`).

must_be_integer_greater_than_zero.means: Not a whole number above zero.

not_an_occurrence.means: The series has no occurrence on that day.

not_supported.means: A field a rule does not have (`by_month_day`, `by_month`, `by_set_pos`, `week_start`…), a field of a `by_day` entry other than `day` and `nth_of_period`, or a list under `exceptions` other than `add` and `change`. Nothing in a rule is ever dropped silently.

notify_attendees_unsupported.means: `notify_attendees: false` on an event with guests in a calendar that always tells them (Microsoft).

required.means: A guest without `email`; `conferencing` without `profile_id`; a changed occurrence with only one of `start` and `end`.

too_big.means: Over a limit: more than 100 entries in `invite` or `remove`, an address over 254 or a name over 256 characters, `interval` over 99, `count` over 730, more than 64 entries in `exceptions.add` or `exceptions.change`.
Too short or too long, or too many items.

too_many_attendees.means: The event would have more than 100 guests.

too_many_channels.means: The account already has 100 open channels.

too_small.means: No rule. (To stop a series send `"recurrence": null`.)
Too short or too long, or too many items.
